resources.string: Live MediaPipe pose skeleton on the AR feed

Point the camera at a person. MediaPipe Pose Landmarker runs on-device on the AR camera image and SceneView projects the landmarks onto a 17-joint ARKit-parity skeleton. Note: ARCore has no native body tracking — this is an image-space pose overlay, not a world-anchored 3D skeleton like ARKit.
Aim the camera at a person
Body tracking is unavailable right now — the rest of the AR scene still works.
Point camera at a person — full body visible
